content.text: {"class": "PRODUCT_DEFECT", "reasoning": "The contract requires summing line items at full precision and rounding HALF_UP exactly once, but the debug logs show Money.of() rounding each line item individually (50.005 -> 50.00, 49.995 -> 49.99) before summation, yielding 99.99 instead of the correct 100.00. This matches the only billing-service change since the last green build, commit 4e8bb07 'refactor: centralise rounding in Money.of()', while the test file has been unchanged since March. The expected value of 100.00 is the contract-correct result, so the test is right and the service is wrong."}
